audit_name: Future Control Forcing Provenance and Sourcing Audit

RETROSPECTIVE.implementation: Slices actual future forcing U(t+1)...U(t+H) from held-out simulation trajectories.
RETROSPECTIVE.scientific_usage: Evaluating model dynamic response assuming perfect future environmental forcing.
RETROSPECTIVE.claim_boundary: Permissible for retrospective model evaluation, but must NOT be claimed as an operational real-time forecast.

OPERATIONAL.provenance: HELD-CONSTANT INITIAL STATE + PARAMETERIZED DIURNAL CYCLE
OPERATIONAL.implementation: Persists u(t0) forward for emissions and meteorology; parameterizes diurnal solar cycle via 750 * sin(pi * (h % 24) / 12).
OPERATIONAL.scientific_usage: Zero-lookahead forward forecasting when future numerical meteorology/emissions are not yet available.
OPERATIONAL.claim_boundary: Legitimate operational rollout capability; subject to persistence uncertainty.

SCENARIO.implementation: Applies user-specified or optimization abatement factors to emission controls (e.g. 0.70x NOx).
SCENARIO.scientific_usage: MPC optimization and counterfactual emission intervention assessment in Phase 4.
SCENARIO.claim_boundary: Counterfactual forward simulation, not a passive forecast.
